text:
ana: CI red on publish stage — image push to our internal registry failed after the docker-squash step. Error snippet below, anyone seen this before?

bryan: can you paste the CI link/logs?

ana: https://ci.redwood/teams/infra/builds/1759 — log excerpt:
```
time="2026-02-23T14:22:11Z" level=error msg="failed to put blob" err="remote error: signature verification failed: digest mismatch"
http status: 400 Bad Request
PUT /v2/infra/service/blobs/uploads/... -> 400
manifest put: processing manifest failed: blob digest conflict
```

marta: we rotated the registry signing key last night for cross-repo dedupe. Could be CI still using old creds. Which k8s secret does the pipeline mount?

ana: pipeline uses secret `infra-builder-token` in namespace `ci`. We updated the k8s secret yesterday but the runner is a long-lived pod, so maybe it didn't pick up the new token.

bryan: hmm also worth considering that docker-squash changes blob contents/digests — if the registry enforces content trust/signatures the squash could produce a new digest that doesn't match an already-signed layer. Try bypassing squash to confirm.

ana: good call. I'll rerun with SKIP_SQUASH=true and DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=0 to rule out signature checks. kicking off rerun now.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by ana (build #1759) — queued on runner `ci-runner-07`.

ci-bot: build #1759 (rerun) reached publish stage — pushing image...

ci-bot: publish failed: 401 Unauthorized: authentication required (token has insufficient scope)

marta: aha — new signing key rotation also changed token scopes. The token we updated in k8s didn't include `repository:push` for that service account. I missed it when updating the terraform.

bryan: ok quick plan: (1) update `infra-builder-token` with the new token that has push scope, (2) ensure runners recycle to pick up secret, (3) re-run without squash to verify.

ana: I've updated the secret to `infra-registry-token-v2` (rolled via terraform) and restarted the runner pods. Restarting `ci-runner-07`.

ci-bot: runner ci-runner-07 restarted.

ana: re-running build #1759 final time (no squash).

ci-bot: publish stage: upload layer blobs...

ci-bot: image push succeeded: registry.redwood.internal/infra/service:build-1759 

deploy-bot: deployed image registry.redwood.internal/infra/service:build-1759 to staging :thumbsup:

bryan: nice. Follow-ups: 1) add a quick check in CI that detects "signature verification" error and auto-falls back to non-squash push + clearer error message; 2) add key-rotation runbook note about restarting long-lived runners and verifying token scopes.

marta: I'll own the runbook update and add a terraform check for token scope.

ana: thanks — saved the release. I'll open a tiny PR to add the CI fallback and link the runbook once marta updates it.

bryan: perfect, thx all.
